newsitem.title: USA: Timken sets two-for-one stock split.
newsitem.headline: Timken sets two-for-one stock split.

text.p: Timken Co said Tuesday it would split its stock two-for-one, effective on or about May 30, record May 16.
The company said the split is possible because of the rise in its share price.
The company said it would pay a regular quarterly dividend of $0.33 a share (on pre-split stock) on June 2, record May 16.

The company also amended and extended its 1996 common stock purchase plan. The plan initially authorized the company to buy back up to two million shares. Under the amended plan, the company said it may continue to buy shares for another 12 months after the original expiration date, but would not buy more than the two million shares authorized.
The company said it would hold the shares in its treasury. As of April 15, about 31 million shares were outstanding.
